types.definition: DB-compatible type for grapes and named grape varieties.
Fresh, dried or processed fruit materials.
Herbs, spices, peels, roots and similar flavoring botanicals.
Brewing, dilution or proofing water when explicitly documented.
Declared additive not better represented by another ingredient type.
DB-compatible fallback for evidenced materials outside the approved six specific ingredient types; never used for unknown values.

roles.definition: Principal base material in the DB ingredient-role contract.
Material contributing fermentable extract in the DB ingredient-role contract.
Botanical used to build aroma or flavor in the DB ingredient-role contract.
Declared flavoring, sweetening, coloring or processing addition in the DB ingredient-role contract; finer meaning remains in source claims.
Water used for brewing, dilution or proof adjustment in the DB ingredient-role contract.

terms.definition: Grape material without a supported variety.
Barley material without a supported malt status.
Rice material without a narrower supported form or variety.
Rice explicitly identified as the Omachi variety.
Rice explicitly identified as glutinous rice.
Millet-family grain where a narrower species is not established.
Cherry fruit explicitly used as a fermentable or flavouring material, including cherry spirit identified as Kirsch.
Plum-family fruit material; exact species and source wording should be retained.
Citrus-family fruit without a narrower supported species.
Berry-family fruit without a narrower supported species.
Tropical fruit without a narrower supported species.
Herbal botanical without a narrower supported species.
Water explicitly documented as an ingredient, brewing water or dilution water.
Caramel colouring explicitly declared; caramel sensory notes are separate.
Yeast culture without a supported strain.
Lactic-acid bacteria culture without a supported strain.
Koji starter without a supported type.
Koji explicitly identified as white koji.
Koji explicitly identified as yellow koji.
Nuruk starter without a supported subtype.

exclusions.reason: Commerce accessories are not alcohol products.
Non-alcoholic mixers and ordinary beverages are outside the alcohol catalog.
Alcohol-free products are not silently mixed into the alcohol taxonomy.

primary_styles.definition: Wine whose reviewed primary presentation is red wine.
Wine whose reviewed primary presentation is white wine.
Wine whose reviewed primary presentation is rosé wine.
Wine supported as sparkling by product evidence; production method remains a separate facet.
primary_styles.definition_source: OIV International Code of Oenological Practices, special wines

primary_styles.definition: Wine supported as fortified or liqueur wine by product evidence.
primary_styles.definition_source: OIV International Code of Oenological Practices, liqueur wine and fortification

primary_styles.definition: White-grape wine supported as made with extended pomace contact; color alone is insufficient.
primary_styles.definition_source: OIV definition of white wine with maceration

primary_styles.definition: Whisky explicitly identified as single malt under its applicable jurisdiction or producer claim.
싱글 그레인과 블렌디드 그레인의 서비스 대표 계열. 버번·라이·위트·콘은 곡물 원료라는 이유로 이 계열에 합치지 않는다.
Whisky explicitly identified as a blend; component types are separate facets when known.
Whisky explicitly designated bourbon under applicable labeling rules.
A blend explicitly identified as composed of malt whiskies from more than one distillery.
Whisky explicitly identified as rye whisky under applicable labeling rules.
Whisky explicitly identified as wheat whisky under applicable labeling rules.
Whisky explicitly identified as corn whisky under applicable labeling rules.
Sake explicitly labeled junmai under the applicable Japanese labeling standard.
primary_styles.definition_source: Japan National Tax Agency specific designation sake overview

primary_styles.definition: Sake explicitly labeled ginjo under the applicable Japanese labeling standard.
primary_styles.definition_source: Japan National Tax Agency specific designation sake overview

primary_styles.definition: Sake explicitly labeled daiginjo under the applicable Japanese labeling standard.
primary_styles.definition_source: Japan National Tax Agency specific designation sake overview

primary_styles.definition: Sake explicitly labeled junmai ginjo.
primary_styles.definition_source: Japan National Tax Agency specific designation sake overview

primary_styles.definition: Sake explicitly labeled junmai daiginjo.
primary_styles.definition_source: Japan National Tax Agency specific designation sake overview

primary_styles.definition: Sake explicitly labeled honjozo.
primary_styles.definition_source: Japan National Tax Agency specific designation sake overview

primary_styles.definition: Sake explicitly identified as ordinary sake rather than a specific-designation sake.
Korean traditional alcohol explicitly classified as takju.
Korean traditional alcohol explicitly classified as yakju.
Korean traditional alcohol explicitly classified as cheongju.
Korean traditional product explicitly classified as fruit wine.
Korean soju explicitly classified as distilled soju.
Korean soju explicitly classified as diluted soju.
포르투갈 도루의 포트로 제품별 출처에서 확인된 주정강화 와인. 루비·토니·화이트 등의 차이와 당도는 별도이며 포트통 숙성 상품은 포함하지 않는다.
헤레스의 셰리로 제품별 출처에서 확인된 주정강화 와인. 피노·올로로소·PX 등의 차이는 별도이며 셰리통 숙성 증류주는 제외한다.
primary_styles.definition_source: Consejo Regulador Jerez, Sherry wine families

primary_styles.definition: 마데이라의 주정강화 와인으로 확인된 제품군. 당도·품종·숙성 연수는 별도이며 마데이라통 숙성 상품은 포함하지 않는다.
제품별 제조사 설명에서 테네시 위스키로 확인된 제품군. 브랜드나 생산지만으로 분류하지 않고 명시된 라이·싱글몰트·블렌드는 각 제품 정체성을 따른다.
발효주에 증류주를 더하는 혼양 방식의 한국 과하주. 약주나 증류식 소주 단독 유형과 구분한다.
Single Pot Still로 식별된 단일 증류소의 몰트·비몰트 곡물 팟스틸 위스키. 싱글몰트로 바꾸지 않는다.
미국 위스키 중 버번·라이·테네시·특정 곡물 등 기존 계열로 설명되지 않는 제품. 원산지 확인을 요구하며 버번 요건을 추정하지 않는다.
제품별 자료에서 베르무트로 식별된 방향성 와인. 일반 화이트·레드·순수 증류주와 구별한다.

descriptors.definition: Parent family for fruit-like sensory notes.
Citrus-family note without a more specific supported descriptor.
Apple-like note; color or ripeness may remain in the source wording.
Parent family for flower-like sensory notes.
White-flower-like note such as acacia or jasmine when not more specific.
Parent family for herbal, grassy, vegetal and tea-like notes.
Vegetal family note without a more specific descriptor.
Parent family for grain, baked and nutty notes.
Parent family for roasted and browned notes.
Toasted bread or toasted material note.
Parent family for sweet-smelling notes; it does not establish measured or perceived sweetness.
Molasses- or dark-sugar-like note; it does not establish the ingredient.
Parent family for woody, oak-associated and vanilla-like notes; it does not prove barrel use.
Oak-like note; maturation vessel must be evidenced separately.
Parent family for smoky, peaty and charred notes.
Peat-like note; peat use in production must be evidenced separately.
Parent family for yeast, starter and fermentation-associated notes.
Koji-associated sensory note; koji use must be evidenced separately.
Nuruk-associated sensory note; nuruk use must be evidenced separately.
Lactic or yoghurt-like note; fermentation method must be evidenced separately.
Parent family for earthy and soil-like notes.
Parent family for mineral-like sensory language; it is not a chemical measurement.
Saline sensory note; measured saltiness is a scalar dimension.
Parent family for dairy-like sensory notes.
Cream-like flavor note; creamy texture is represented by viscosity or body.
Parent family for savory flavor notes.
Parent family for chemically described notes that may be neutral, characteristic or faulty depending on context.
Sulfur-associated note; no fault judgment is implied.
Solvent- or nail-polish-like note; no fault judgment is implied.
Medicinal- or antiseptic-like note; no fault judgment is implied.

scalar_dimensions.definition: Perceived sweetness, distinct from analytical sugar.
Perceived acidity, not laboratory total acidity.
Perceived weight and fullness in the mouth.
Perceived carbonation intensity, not package pressure.
How distinctly the principal notes are perceived, distinct from intensity.
Perceived transition from lingering or coating to clean and resolved; it is not a quality score.

process_kinds.definition: Preparation, maceration or extraction before or around fermentation and distillation.
Still type, distillation sequence or operating method.
Maturation stage represented by process terms when needed.
A distinct finishing stage after principal maturation.
Combination of lots, bases, vintages or components.
Method by which dissolved carbon dioxide is obtained.
Approved process term not covered by the other controlled process stages; never used for unknown values.

process_terms.definition: Maceration of a documented material is explicitly described.
Malt dried over peat smoke is explicitly documented for the product or its distillery.
Certified organic farming or production is explicitly documented.
Certified biodynamic farming is explicitly documented.
The producer presents the wine as natural wine; a claim, not a certification.
A selected or cultured fermentation organism is explicitly documented.
The producer explicitly documents spontaneous fermentation.
More than one documented microorganism or culture participates in fermentation.
Malolactic conversion is explicitly documented.
Saccharification and alcoholic fermentation are explicitly documented as proceeding in parallel.
Yeast starter made by the traditional kimoto method with natural lactic bacteria.
Yeast starter made by the yamahai method, kimoto without the mashing step.
Pot-still or batch distillation is explicitly documented.
Column or continuous distillation is explicitly documented.
A single distillation pass is explicitly documented.
Two distillation passes are explicitly documented.
Three distillation passes are explicitly documented.
Distillation at normal atmospheric pressure is explicitly documented (常圧蒸留); it carries heavier aroma compounds over than reduced-pressure distillation.
Reduced-pressure distillation is explicitly documented.
Components from more than one vintage are explicitly documented.
Components from more than one cask are explicitly documented.
A solera or fractional-blending system is explicitly documented.
Release blended from a small, named number of casks or a single small run.
Chill filtration is explicitly documented.
A non-chill-filtered claim is explicitly documented.
Charcoal or activated-carbon filtration is explicitly documented.
An unfiltered claim is explicit; visible haze alone is insufficient.
Pressed through a coarse mesh so lees remain and the drink is cloudy.
Pasteurisation is explicitly documented.
An unpasteurised or raw claim is explicitly documented.
Cold stabilisation is explicitly documented.
Secondary fermentation in bottle is explicitly documented.
Secondary fermentation in a closed tank is explicitly documented.
Exogenous carbonation is explicitly documented.
Bottled at the strength it left the cask, without dilution to a standard ABV.
Bottled without adding water after pressing or distillation.
Explicit wording claims rice and water only. Preserve the stated scope without inferring absent yeast, junmai grade, additive absence or removing existing ingredient facts.
Addition of a documented spirit or alcohol for fortification is explicitly supported.

maturation_kinds.definition: Physical vessel used for maturation or holding.
Documented wood species or broad wood family.
Documented previous content of a maturation vessel.
Toast, char or related documented vessel treatment.
Finishing, fractional aging or another maturation sequence.

maturation_terms.definition: Maturation in a wooden cask is explicitly documented, without a supported wood species.
Holding or maturation in stainless steel is explicitly documented.
Fermentation, holding or maturation in amphora or a documented clay vessel.
Holding or maturation in a concrete vessel is explicitly documented.
A documented period of bottle ageing precedes release.
Oak is documented without a narrower species or origin.
American oak is explicitly documented; exact species may remain in source text.
European oak is explicitly documented; exact species and origin may remain in source text.
Mizunara oak is explicitly documented.
A new or first-fill unused oak cask is explicitly documented.
A cask previously holding bourbon is explicitly documented.
A sherry-seasoned or former sherry cask is explicitly documented; the exact wording is retained.
A cask previously holding wine is explicitly documented; wine type is stored separately when known.
A cask previously holding port is explicitly documented.
A cask previously holding rum is explicitly documented.
A cask previously holding rye whiskey is explicitly documented.
A cask previously holding beer (IPA, stout, ale) is explicitly documented.
A cask previously holding brandy is explicitly documented.
Cask toasting is explicitly documented; toast level is stored separately if available.
Cask charring is explicitly documented; char level is stored separately if available.
A distinct finishing maturation stage is explicitly documented; finishing vessel is linked separately.
A solera or other fractional-aging regime is explicitly documented.
The release is explicitly matured and released from one cask.
Matured for years beyond the usual release age; for sake, koshu.
